channel.title: AI GridWatch — Colorado data center updates
channel.description: Data center moratoriums, proposals, and community-impact headlines for Colorado, from AI GridWatch.

item.title: Larimer County: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: Initial 30-day moratorium extended 6 months after Feb 9 public hearing; prohibits land use applications for new data centers in unincorporated county while staff develops regulations

item.title: Boulder County: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: Up to 6-month pause on planning applications for data centers and detention centers (unanimous); county reviewing Land Use Code

item.title: Aurora: data center moratorium — Rejected
item.description: Emergency resolution for a 6-month moratorium on data-center construction failed 6-5, Mayor Mike Coffman casting the tiebreaking vote against; council instead passed a resolution to develop data-center standards (water/zoning) within 35 days, without a pause.

item.title: Denver: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: 1 year or until updated data center regulations are adopted

item.title: Lochbuie: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: 5-year pause approved 6-1 — the longest active moratorium in Colorado. Residents cited drought as the driving concern

item.title: Broomfield: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: Ordinance 2313, passed 9-0. Covers facilities with a projected load of 10 MW or more; runs through Dec 2, 2027 or until permanent rules are adopted
